summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Vesta Real Estate Corporation (Corporación Inmobiliaria Vesta, S.A.B. de C.V.) containing management's discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations for the three-month periods ended March 31, 2026 and 2025. The filing includes the MD&A exhibit and the CFO's signature. There is no event constituting a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change. The filing is a standard periodic report under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16.
